description: You are an independent SAT tutor managing 6 students. Create a professional tutoring session ledger that tracks all sessions, calculates payment status, and identifies billing discrepancies. The file /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/tutor_rough_notes.txt contains messy handwritten notes that need to be converted into a proper ledger with session details, payment tracking, student summaries, and business totals. Organize the data in /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/session_ledger.xlsx with formulas for calculations.
